standard_prerequisites.name: The notion of a left dual of an object of a monoidal category, witnessed by a unit and a counit whose composites with the coherence maps are identities
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked in the statement (source lines 3089-3091) and in the counted proof (source lines 3105-3116) as a cross-chapter pointer
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the two identities that the proof unfolds at the start.

standard_prerequisites.name: The description of the unit as a sum of finitely many products of local sections near a point, and the adjunction between morphisms of modules
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Used inside the counted proof at source lines 3117-3128
standard_prerequisites.use: Produces the finite free module through which the identity factors locally.

core_obligations: Unfold the duality: the proof starts from the two displayed composites of the unit and the counit that are required to be the identity maps (proof lines 3105-3116)

Local factorisation: at a point the unit is a finite sum of products of local sections, and those sections define a map from a finite free module onto the module together with a factorisation of the unit through that free module tensored with the dual (proof lines 3117-3128)
Diagram: the resulting commutative diagram exhibits the identity of the module as factoring locally through a finite free module, which is assertion (1) (proof lines 3129-3144)

Remaining assertions: (2) and (3) are obtained from the corresponding categorical statements, and the proof also indicates how to deduce them from the uniqueness of left duals and the construction of the standard example (proof lines 3144-3150)
proof_roadmap: 由左对偶的两条单位-余单位恒等式出发；在 x 处把 η(1) 写成有限和 ∑ f_i g_i，用 f_i 定义满射 O_U^{⊕n} → F|_U，并把 η|_U 分解为 O_U → O_U^{⊕n} ⊗ G|_U。
由交换图知 F 上的恒等映射局部通过有限自由模分解，即 (1)；(2)(3) 由范畴层面的左对偶引理及其证明（或由左对偶唯一性与标准例子）得到。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement collects three facts about a module admitting a left dual: it is locally a direct summand of a finite free module, the dual is the module of homomorphisms into the structure sheaf through an explicit map, and the counit is given by evaluating the inverse (author lemma at source lines 3085-3102, label lemma-left-dual-module). The proof (source lines 3104-3151) unfolds the two duality identities, writes the unit at a point as a finite sum of products of local sections, builds the resulting finite free module and the factorisation of the unit through it, and exhibits a commutative diagram showing that the identity of the module factors locally through that free module (proof lines 3117-3144); the remaining two assertions are referred to the corresponding categorical statements, with an indication of an alternative deduction. The local factorisation of the identity is the content. H3.
